item.title: Network & K8s.06-2 Other Clouds, Same Questions
item.description: Ask GCP and Azure the same four questions asked of AWS: how far the virtual network reaches, what a subnet is bound to, who filters traffic, and where Pod IPs come from. Covers GKE VPC-native alias ranges and NEG container-native load balancing, AKS overlay versus flat Azure CNI models and the kubenet retirement, and a three-cloud comparison updated from the 2021 book.
